title: Moon phases
info: The Moon looks different through the month: new, crescent, quarter, gibbous, and full.
Half of the Moon is always lit by the Sun. We see different amounts of that lit half.
A full cycle of phases takes about 29.5 days. Phases are not Earth's shadow. That shadow makes a lunar eclipse.

options: we see different amounts of the Moon's sunlit half
Earth's shadow covers the Moon every night
the Moon turns its light on and off
